description:
Browse what the government buys, with contract spend. kind: psc (products and services)
    | naics (industries). No group and no query -> the groups (PSC: services by letter, e.g. D =
    IT services, R = professional support; products by 2 digits, e.g. 84 = clothing and
    individual equipment; NAICS: 2-digit sectors), largest first. group -> the codes in it.
    query -> codes whose name contains the words. Default year: last complete fiscal year.
    Use a code or its name in a plan's psc / naics filter.

fiscal_year.description: Federal fiscal year (October-September), e.g. 2025; default the last complete one.
fiscal_year.title: Fiscal Year

group.description: A group to list the codes in: a PSC letter or 2-character group (e.g. "D", "84") or a 2-digit NAICS sector (e.g. "54").
group.title: Group

query.description: Words in a code's name, e.g. "body armor", "janitorial".
query.title: Query

name: browse_codes
title: Browse industry and product codes
